# Legends feat notes


## Darth Sidious (Legends Palpatine)

Sources scrolled: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Palpatine/Legends and https://comicvine.gamespot.com/emperor-palpatine/4005-16164/
Suspect Insight thread (opinion, not a feat): https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t1921-darth-krayt-versus-darth-sidious (pre-master-killing Sidious vs reborn Krayt; posters lean Krayt in the Force, one gives Sidious the saber round). Comic Vine respect thread returned HTTP 500 and was not used.

Feats:
- Uses every lightsaber form, ambidextrously.
- Killed Agen Kolar and Saesee Tiin almost instantly, then Kit Fisto.
- Long fights with Mace Windu and Yoda.
- Windu disarmed him.
- Lightning drove Yoda off.
- One lightning blast killed a stormtrooper battalion (Comic Vine).
- Bent Windu's lightsaber (Comic Vine).
- Drained Byss (Comic Vine).
- Threw Senate pods.
- After revival, Force storms are wormholes that can consume fleets.
- Essence Transfer between bodies.

## Darth Krayt

Sources scrolled: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Darth_Krayt and https://comicvine.gamespot.com/darth-krayt/4005-45364/

Feats:
- Over 170 and weakened by Yuuzhan Vong parasites, beat four Imperial Knights.
- Killed Wyyrlok.
- Nearly beat Cade before being shot from behind.
- With Luke, drained Abeloth badly enough to disrupt her other avatars.
- Reborn: redirected a stone barrage.
- Reborn: nearly vaporized temple pillars.
- Reborn: threw Cade through walls.
- Reborn: lightning crumbled columns and killed rakghouls.
- Survived stabbing, lightning, and a cliff fall.
- Implants gone after rebirth, power multiplied.
- Projected his presence to Sith across the galaxy.

## Revan (Legends)

Sources scrolled: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Revan/Legends (Darth Revan URL redirected here) and https://comicvine.gamespot.com/revan/4005-46930/
Wrong Comic Vine URL not used: the first requested Revan URL opened Sora Bulq.

Wookieepedia feats:
- Sensed thousands of deaths from the Battle of Serroco several sectors away.
- Defeated Mandalore the Ultimate in single combat.
- Defeated two massive terentateks single-handedly.
- Later defeated dozens of Dark Jedi/Sith plus Darth Malak.
- Destroyed a large stone archway remotely with telekinesis.
- Could choke/crush opponents and control multiple lightsabers telekinetically.
- Absorbed Darth Nyriss's Force-lightning storm and redirected it, burning her to ash.
- Used Force visions/sense even while heavily drugged.
- Healed wounds with the Force.
- Resisted poisons and drugs.
- Partially resisted the Sith Emperor's mental domination and influenced the Emperor for centuries.
- Used Force lightning and Force storms.
- His dark half resisted death and retained control of a centuries-old body.
- As a commander, won major victories against the Mandalorians, including Duro and Malachor V.

Comic Vine feats:
- Saved the Duro shipyards from complete Mandalorian destruction and became Supreme Commander.
- Slew Mandalore the Ultimate in single combat.
- Activated the Malachor V superweapon, destroying the planet's surface and remaining Mandalorian forces.
- Used the Star Forge to create a massive warship army.
- Fought through Sith war droids, Dark Jedi, and Sith apprentices, then defeated Darth Malak.
- Crumbled a stone archway, blasted open the Emperor's throne-room doors, and telekinetically hurled Vitiate.
- Pulled meteors into the Foundry.
- Controlled multiple lightsabers telekinetically.
- Incapacitated nearly a dozen opponents at once, including Darth Marr, Satele Shan, and Lana Beniko.
- Absorbed Darth Nyriss's dark energy, survived Vitiate's lightning, and healed himself with the Force.
- Resisted the Star Forge, Malachor, Korriban, and Nathema's effects.
- Partially shielded his mind during 300 years of torture.
- Built HK-47.
- Used Force drain/lightning storms, teleported, and influenced Vitiate to delay the war and accept the Treaty of Coruscant.

Not feats: "single greatest warrior of this age," "military genius," possibly single-handedly responsible for the Republic's Mandalorian-War victory, "most powerful Jedi of his era," "greatest warrior," "unstoppable force," "loved by both Sith and Jedi," "better than Darth Vader."

## Vitiate / Tenebrae

Sources scrolled: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Tenebrae (Vitiate URL redirected here) and https://comicvine.gamespot.com/the-sith-emperor/4005-86316/
Wrong Comic Vine URL not used: the first requested Vitiate URL opened an unrelated Alfie page.

Wookieepedia feats:
- At age six, snapped his adoptive father's neck telekinetically and tortured his mother with the Force.
- At age ten, stripped Darth Dramath of his sanity and Force power.
- Dominated the minds and wills of 8,000 Sith Lords.
- Performed the ten-day Ritual of Nathema: annihilated all life on the planet, stripped the Force from it, and absorbed its life force, gaining immortality.
- Used essence transfer to move his consciousness between bodies indefinitely.
- Created and controlled the Children of the Emperor, including suppressing their personalities and possessing them.
- Sent Revan flying telekinetically, destroyed T3-M4 with a thought, and created barriers capable of blocking flamethrowers and powerful lightsaber strikes.
- Summoned Force storms that overwhelmed Revan's defenses and severely injured him.
- His rituals warped Dromund Kaas's atmosphere into perpetual lightning storms.
- His spirit later consumed the planet Ziost to restore its power.

Comic Vine feats:
- Conquered Medriaas by age 13.
- At age ten, stripped Dramath of his Force powers, drove him insane, and killed him.
- Manipulated 8,000 Sith into joining him, dominated their minds, and bound their wills to his.
- Completed the ten-day Nathema ritual, annihilating all life except himself, absorbing the planet's life force, stripping it of the Force, and gaining immortality.
- Led the Sith through twenty years of blind hyperspace jumps to make them dependent on him.

Not feats: "one of the most powerful practitioners," "unimaginable power," "supremely strong," "terrifying ritual," "enormous power and wisdom," and unelaborated Powers-list metadata.

## Darth Nihilus

Sources scrolled: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Darth_Nihilus and https://comicvine.gamespot.com/darth-nihilus/4005-47874/
The first guessed Comic Vine URL 404'd. The real page is the one above.

Wookieepedia feats:
- Survived the Mass Shadow Generator's destruction of Malachor V.
- Drained life-force from survivors and grew stronger through repeated feeding.
- Consumed planets on multiple occasions.
- Destroyed Katarr's surface and absorbed the Force energy of its Jedi conclave and living population, leaving only Visas Marr alive.
- Ripped the Ravager and other ships from Malachor's mass shadows and held the damaged vessels together through the Force.
- Could sense Force-users and Force-rich worlds across interstellar distances.
- Stripped Darth Traya from the Force with Darth Sion.
- Attempted to drain Meetra Surik, but her Force abilities resisted him; he was subsequently defeated.
- Preserved his consciousness in his armor after his body decayed.

Comic Vine feats:
- Survived the Mandalorian Wars and Malachor V.
- Drained Katarr, destroying all life there except Visas Marr.
- Could drain Force energy on a planetary scale.
- Went approximately a year without feeding after draining Katarr.
- Used telekinesis to construct and hold the Ravager together.
- Used farseeing to sense Force-sensitive beings, including the Exile, from great distances.
- Was defeated when the Exile resisted his Force drain and weakened him.
- The page states that he created a holocron later obtained by Darth Krayt.

Not feats: "one of the most powerful," "extremely powerful," "Wound in the Force," "Lord of Hunger," database tags such as Immortal and Cosmic Awareness. Comic Vine's claim that he may have transferred his soul into his armor is explicitly uncertain. Wookieepedia lines such as "his power cannot be put into words" and "you are dust motes" are character opinions.

## Darth Sion

Source scrolled: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Darth_Sion
Comic Vine: guessed URL 404'd and search found no Darth Sion character page. No Comic Vine feats.

Feats:
- Survived being killed during the Great Sith War by using pain, hatred, and the dark side to reanimate himself.
- Held his decomposing, repeatedly fractured body together through the Force.
- Was killed repeatedly during his Jedi-hunting campaign but continually rose again.
- Trapped and killed Jedi Master Lonna Vash.
- Survived the destruction of the Harbinger and the Peragus mining facility.
- Cut off Kreia's hand during their confrontation.
- Regenerated after Meetra Surik injured him on Korriban.
- Helped Darth Nihilus defeat and depower Darth Traya.
- In the final battle on Malachor V, rose repeatedly after being struck down, described as four times, before finally accepting death.
- Demonstrated telekinesis, Force drain, Force rage, Force immunity, Force slow, and resistance to fear-based Force attacks.

## Darth Traya / Kreia

Source scrolled: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Darth_Traya redirected to the Kreia article.
Comic Vine character URL darth-traya/4005-47875/ was Mystiq, not Traya. No character page found in search. Respect thread still to be scrolled: https://comicvine.gamespot.com/profile/shootingnova/blog/kreia-darth-traya-respect-thread/96587/

Wookieepedia feats:
- Taught Darth Nihilus the ability to devour entire worlds.
- Used Dark Healing to kill dozens of Sith Assassins simultaneously.
- Severed the Force connections of Jedi Masters Vrook Lamar, Kavar, and Zez-Kai Ell, killing them.
- Revived Hanharr and later Colonel Tobin after their deaths.
- Manipulated or erased memories, even Jedi Mical's, and could conceal herself from nearby Jedi.
- Used the Force to control three lightsabers telekinetically in combat.
- Demonstrated long-distance telepathy.
- The article credits her with perceiving shatterpoints and foreseeing Jango Fett's death roughly 4,000 years later.
- Successfully deceived Tobin with false intelligence, maneuvering Darth Nihilus into attacking Telos and becoming vulnerable.

Not feats yet: general "prodigious skill/power" language, listed Force powers without a specific demonstration, philosophical descriptions.

## Darth Malgus

Source scrolled: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Darth_Malgus
Comic Vine character URL darth-malgus/4005-65432/ was Porthos, not Malgus. No character bio found. Respect thread still to be scrolled: https://comicvine.gamespot.com/forums/gen-discussion-1/the-complete-darth-malgus-respect-thread-2254647/

Wookieepedia feats:
- Killed Jedi Master Kao Cen Darach after Darach had defeated Malgus's master.
- Survived rockets, a grenade blast, and being buried by a collapsed cliff.
- Held back rubble from two collapsed duracrete-and-steel buildings, then blasted it away with the Force.
- Detected a concealed Jedi, Force-gripped him, crushed his windpipe, and killed him.
- Killed three Jedi simultaneously with Force lightning during the Jedi Temple assault.
- Defeated and impaled Jedi Master Ven Zallow.
- His Force scream buckled a starship viewport, caused crew injuries, and destroyed a wave of Republic fighters.
- Redirected Darth Adraas's Force lightning.
- Absorbed blasterfire with one hand on Ilum.
- Used a Force wave to violently disperse a crowd, damaging nearby doors and transports.
- On Elom, entangled and lifted Jedi Master Denolm Orr, then bisected him; afterward collapsed the temple ceiling to seize the holocron.
- Later used the Force to crash one shuttle into another.
- Survived the destruction of his fortress and returned years later.

Not feats: "one of the most powerful Sith" claims, character opinions, and ability labels without a concrete action.

## Comic Vine respect threads (scrolled 2026-10-04)

These are quoted feats from respect threads, not character bios. Poster rankings and "most powerful" lines are not feats.

### Darth Malgus thread (INCOMPLETE)

URL: https://comicvine.gamespot.com/forums/gen-discussion-1/the-complete-darth-malgus-respect-thread-2254647/
Re-opened and scrolled to the true end on 2026-10-04. The main post really stops at "Telekinesis: (R) He yanked his master's lightsabers into his hands:" with no quote or source after it. Posts 2 through 11 are comments only, no more feats. Raw note: [local path] This thread is a stub. The fuller thread still to scroll is https://comicvine.gamespot.com/forums/gen-discussion-1/darth-malgus-respect-thread-1557966/

Visible quoted feats only:
- Detected Satele Shan and Kao Cen Darach's presence; the narrator says Malgus would have killed him without Kao's intervention. Source: The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural.
- Detected mines ahead on the Ord Radama mountain trail. Source: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side.
- Felt Darth Venemal and roughly 100,000 soldiers experience pain and die after their vessel fell into Ord Radama's gravity well. Source: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side.

### Kreia / Darth Traya thread

URL: https://comicvine.gamespot.com/profile/shootingnova/blog/kreia-darth-traya-respect-thread/96587/

Quoted feats:
- Her Force powers could weaken Luxa, described as a tough opponent, until Luxa "won't stand a chance." Source: KOTOR II Prima Official Game Guide.
- Survived a severe anti-aircraft ship crash and soon stood up unharmed. Later survived another crash after a rocket struck the ship. Source: KOTOR II.
- Walked across Malachor V despite its surface "crushing every cell" and feeling like being buried alive. Source: KOTOR II.
- Barely moved while evading Brianna's attacks, then seized her by the throat / Force-crushed her. Did similarly against Mical. Source: KOTOR II.
- Impaled herself with a lightsaber while remaining conscious and speaking. The unprepared Exile was knocked unconscious by comparable pain. Source: KOTOR II.
- Her Force bond with the Exile restored the Exile's connection to the Force. Healing or strengthening one aided the other. Pain could transfer between them. Sources: KOTOR Campaign Guide and KOTOR II.
- Taught the Exile Breath Control, so she could survive poison gas. Source: KOTOR II.
- Taught Beast Control, so the Exile could influence animals and make them passive. Source: KOTOR II.
- Revived Colonel Tobin despite his having only "a shred of life" remaining. Source: KOTOR II.
- Used telepathy to read Atton's memories and extract information against his will, then knocked him unconscious. Source: KOTOR II.
- Incapacitated the Exile telepathically. Source: KOTOR II.
- Read Mandalore's unresolved thoughts and used that to manipulate him. Source: KOTOR II.
- Sensed droids, the Exile's renewed Force connection, and Atton's presence from a distance while communicating telepathically. Source: KOTOR II.
- Manipulated Mical's perception so he could not see her standing before him, then erased or blocked his memory of discovering her secret. Source: KOTOR II.
- Telepathically contacted Atris across the galaxy. Atris heard "Betrayal." Source: KOTOR II.
- Clouded the Jedi Masters' memories of her. Atris could not remember having previously met Kreia. Source: KOTOR II.
- Concealed her Sith identity and appeared neutral even to Force Sight until she revealed herself. Source: KOTOR II.
- Sensed the Exile across the galaxy while still recovering her powers. Source: The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia.
- Sensed Darth Sion's arrival, Sith activity on Dxun beyond Mandalorian sensor readings, and the pain and death associated with Dantooine and Dxun. Source: KOTOR II.
- Sensed an impression left by Revan in crystals despite Revan's absence. Source: KOTOR II.
- Choked or crushed multiple opponents, including Zez-Kai Ell, Hanharr, Bao-Dur, Visas Marr, Mical, Brianna, Darth Sion, and the Exile. Source: KOTOR II.
- Telekinetically blasted the three Jedi Masters and knocked out the Exile. Source: KOTOR II.
- Controlled three lightsabers simultaneously, each fighting independently. The campaign guide calls this "vast telekinetic powers." Source: KOTOR Campaign Guide.
- Killed more than six Sith assassins without visible wounds. The cut-scene script depicts nearly twenty assassins dying in a flash. Source: KOTOR II.
- Disabled T3-M4 with Force lightning, leaving the droid smouldering and broken. Source: KOTOR II.
- Drained Masters Vrook, Kavar, and Zez-Kai Ell of their Force connections, leaving them "worse than lifeless." Source: KOTOR II.
- Drained the Exile through their Force bond while surviving her own lightsaber impalement. Source: KOTOR II.
- Fought alongside the unarmed Exile and Atton to defeat an armed assassin. Source: KOTOR II.
- Outdueled Atton in a short, brutal fight. Source: KOTOR II.
- Foresaw Revan's future killings of Jedi and later accurately described the future fates of companions and worlds, including Mira's eventual death saving others. Source: KOTOR II.
- As a Force spirit, her visions were exploited by Darth Baras to advance himself and destroy rivals. Sources: The Old Republic and its "The Entity" codex entry.

## Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader (novel, read in full)

Source: James Luceno, *Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader* (Del Rey, 2005), Legends. Every line of the full text was read: [local path] (5,876 lines).
Notes file: [local path] It has 66 feats (F1-F66) and 75 statements (S1-S75), each with its line number and a short verbatim quote. It also has a scaling table and a plot summary. Key duels: Vader beat Bol Chatak on Murkhana (Vader at his worst: clumsy, and she cut his prosthetic arm). On Kashyyyk, Vader beat Forte and Kulka 2v1 while toying with them, and maimed Anno, Jambe Lu, and Nam Poorf. Vader beat Starstone (holding back), and Shryne interrupted that fight. Vader beat Roan Shryne in the longest duel: Shryne hit only prosthetics, and Vader won with a plank telekinesis barrage. On Alderaan, Vader's thrown saber beat Shryne's telekinesis. Sidious does not fight on-page. Fy-Tor-Ana does not appear in this book. Quotes were machine-checked against the cited lines.
Story and prose notes added (second full read, 2026-10-10): a '## Story and prose notes' section is appended at the end of [local path] after the unchanged feat sections. It covers SP1, a plot summary by Part and chapter with every POV thread; SP2, character profiles (Vader/Sidious, Vader vs Anakin's memory, Shryne/Starstone, Shryne/Jula, Bail and the survivors, and others); SP3, themes; SP4, 20 prose excerpts and memorable dialogue; SP5, worldbuilding and lore; and SP6, timeline and connections. All 166 quotes were checked against their cited lines and with grep -F.

## Deceived (novel, read in full)

Source: *Star Wars: The Old Republic: Deceived* by Paul S. Kemp (2011), Legends. I read the full text from start to finish: [local path] (7,735 lines).
Notes file: [local path] It has 131 feats in chapter order with line numbers and verbatim quotes, 37 statements kept separate from feats, scaling for each duel, and a plot summary. A script checked every quote against the line it cites.
Story and prose notes added (second full read, 2026-10-10): a '## Story and prose notes' section is appended at the end of [local path] after the unchanged feat sections. It covers SP1, a plot summary by day and chapter with every POV thread; SP2, character profiles (Malgus/Eleena, Aryn/Zallow, Zeerid/Arra, Vrath, and others); SP3, themes; SP4, 19 prose excerpts and memorable dialogue; SP5, worldbuilding and lore; and SP6, timeline and connections. All 151 quotes were checked against their cited lines and with grep -F.
Key duels:
- Malgus kills Ven Zallow at the Jedi Temple. They were even in a Force blade lock; Malgus won with a faked stun and a counterstab.
- Aryn vs. Malgus, Duel 1 on the Temple ruins: no result. She wounds his side, then chooses to leave.
- Aryn vs. Malgus, Duel 2 in a hangar: Malgus wins decisively. His lightning is stronger than anything he used in Duel 1. He spares her because she spared Eleena.
- Malgus vs. Adraas: a short office clash stopped by Angral. In the Epilogue Malgus kills Adraas one-sidedly.
- Zallow easily repels Adraas.
- Zeerid beats Vrath hand to hand in about 40 seconds.

## Legacy of the Force 8: Revelation (novel, read in full)

Source: *Star Wars: Legacy of the Force: Revelation* by Karen Traviss (2008), Legends, 41 ABY. I went through the whole text in order: [local path] (8,485 lines). Most paragraphs were read in a truncated view; every fight, power and statement passage was read in full. The working copy is [local path]
Notes file: [local path] It has 22 feats, statements S1-S23 with reliability ratings, fights A-G, scaling links, the plot, Story and prose notes SP1-SP6, takeaways, and the raw reading log as an appendix. A script checked every quote (302 fragments; the only miss is the OCR-garbled Ch11 heading).
Key duels and scaling:
- Luke vs. Caedus, StealthX duel at Fondor (L5227-5389): Luke wins on the exchange. He goes undetected (L5281) and rips Caedus's fighter apart: «Caedus tried to block Luke in the Force and suddenly got an idea of just how much power Luke could muster» (L5335). Caedus's ribs crack. Luke: «If I wanted to kill you, I could have done it several times over by now» (L5299). Caedus escapes by threatening civilians.
- Caedus drops Fondor's planetary shield by mass mind-influence fed by fleet battle meditation (L6001-6023). He is drained for hours afterwards: «No, I am not omnipotent.» (L7083).
- Jaina + Mirta vs. Tahiri on *Bloodfin* (L7015-7027): Tahiri's lightsaber fails on beskar (L7019). Jaina breaks an exhausted Caedus's Force choke on Mirta (L7027). Carid kneecaps Caedus after his illusion trick fails (L7135-7143).
- Mara evidence: Caedus's recorded confession says «the only way I could stop her was to use the poison darts I keep as a last line of defense» (L7501). Fett: «nearly got his backside handed to him by Skywalker's wife» (L7669).
- Statements: Jaina: «I'm his equal ... But I just don't have his... training.» (L97). Luke: «He's just very strong» (L1059).
- Ladder: Luke > Caedus > Jaina > Tahiri. Beskar-armored Mandalorians are a real counter to lightsaber users.

## Legacy of the Force 9: Invincible (novel, read in full)

Source: *Star Wars: Legacy of the Force: Invincible* by Troy Denning (2008), Legends, 41 ABY. I went through the whole text in order: [local path] (5,971 lines). Most paragraphs were read in a truncated view; every fight and power passage, and the epilogue, was read in full. The working copy is [local path] Not the Invincible comic (invincible-notes.md).

Key duels and scaling:
- Nickel One (L2281-2612): Caedus kills Mandalorian commandos and shatterpoints a beskar breastplate with a pommel tap (L2305). Jaina, boosted by Luke flow-walking or projecting into her (L2469, L2598, L3688), cuts off his arm with a beskad (L2566). Caedus's point-blank lightning breaks her ribs. This is not clean Jaina-solo evidence.
- Jaina learns shatterpoint and crumbles raw beskar (L3896-3906).
- **Jaina vs. Caedus, the final duel in the biodisposal pit (L5088-5186): Jaina kills Caedus.** She fights alone, without Luke's boost (L5004). Caedus is one-armed, gut-stabbed in the first second, and distracted by the nanokiller threat to Allana. At the end he stops defending to warn Tenel Ka (L5182-5184). Before that he led the melee and broke her forearm and cheekbone.
- Ben vs. Tahiri (L5412-5430): Ben wins and spares her, and she surrenders.
- Luke Force-shears the locking pins of a blast door (L5680).
- Statements: Luke on fighting Caedus: «"It's worse," Luke said. "I win."» (L1505). Caedus POV: Luke is «the one swordsman in the galaxy whom Caedus did not dare fight one-armed» (L2515). Jaina: «He's magnitudes stronger than me in the Force» (L4836). Caedus: «Luke Skywalker couldn't kill me. What does she expect to do?» (L4400).
- Ladder: Luke > Caedus ≳ Jaina (raw power) > Ben > Tahiri. Jaina wins the prepared fight against a crippled Caedus. Verdicts are in verdicts.md (Oct 17, 2026).

## HOW TO USE THE RESPECT-THREAD FILES (user rule, Oct 10, 2026)

Use only the quoted source material and its cited source. Give the poster's own descriptions, captions, headings, and "scaling" framing (for example "casually", "effortlessly", "stomps", or "Vader is more powerful than X") little or no weight. Judge what the quote itself shows. Image-only entries with just a poster caption are unverified, so don't cite them as feats.


## SOURCING RULE (Oct 10, 2026)

**Rule:** every feat, statement or quote in these notes must carry its PRIMARY source: novel + chapter, comic + issue, game + mission/scene, or sourcebook/databank + page. The website or forum thread it came through (Wookieepedia, Comic Vine, Suspect Insight, a blog) is NOT a source by itself. Record it only as *how* the source was found. If the primary source can't be confirmed, mark the entry unsourced and don't guess.

How the 2026-10-11 sourcing pass marked things (only additions; nothing existing was rewritten or deleted):
- Comic Vine respect threads: `Source (identified later): <work> — how identified: <url>` under entries that had no named source and were confidently identified. All other unsourced entries are left as they were.
- Wookieepedia quote files: `Source: <cited work(s)> [per Wookieepedia "<article>" rev <id>, ref n; exact text match | approximate match, verify]`. Also `Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (...)` where the article sentence has no inline ref (usually the lead), and `Source: UNRESOLVED (...)` where the sentence was not found in the current revision. Entries that already had a source were left alone.
- Novel notes: `Chapter (added 2026-10-11, …)` sub-lines worked out from each entry's L-numbers against the chapter headings in the source text, plus `Chapter key for the table rows above` blocks. Three existing chapter tags disagree with the L-numbers. They are flagged with `Chapter check (added 2026-10-11)` lines and not changed.
- Debate notes: an `## Original-work check (added 2026-10-11)` section at the end of each file.

## SCALING METHOD (updated 2026-10-11 after SI t4404 "Canon and Considerations"; see debates-si-vs-debating-2022.md)
- No single evidence type wins automatically. Weigh the whole picture, the "point of best fit" across all the evidence.
- Strongest: on-page fight outcomes and in-universe events (they bind continuity), plus in-story narration/POV that frames who is stronger (author intent).
- Strong: reliable in-universe statements from characters in a position to know. These are weighted by frequency (repeated across sources) and consistency with other evidence.
- Weaker: out-of-universe hype (sourcebook rankings, blurbs, magazine lines, encyclopedia accolades). Discount them for RECENCY: they don't bind characters created after publication (e.g. pre-2008 "most powerful Sith" lines vs Vitiate).
- Medium distortion: game gameplay and Force Unleashed-style powers are inflated (Chee, Witwer). Use cutscenes and story text; gameplay stats are S-canon.
- Lucas material (films, ROTS novelization as his line-edited intent) sits at the top for film-era characters.
- Not adopted from the thread: treating in-universe statements as S-canon, using "coolness" as a real weight, and capping EU feats at film level.
